references.label: Bonus-grid three-bank
references.description: The center drops that fill the selected grid row and advance Bonus X when completed.

references.label: Numbered five-bank
references.description: The left 1-to-5 drops that advance Bonus X and award the ordered-bank bonus.

references.label: Ball Walker
references.description: The elevated mechanism that loads two balls and receives the third-ball start shot.

references.label: SKY DIVERS spellout
references.description: The runway letters that must be lit before the Walker can release three-ball play.
